activity_summary: You stayed in for the afternoon. The Knave went on without you. The loaf was still a finger short. The board was threepence. You told them the leaf upstairs was still not to be sent.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was not in the afternoon's play and stayed.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the board at threepence and kept the letter off any carrier.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Showed the loaf still short of the notch.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not in it. I am not going back.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: It is still a finger short.
